wsjHeadlines.description: Under the proposal, the bank would be required to hold 90% in top-tier capital against its foreign subsidiaries, down from 100% the government previously planned.

wsjHeadlines.title: Societe Generale Shares Climb After Bank Raises Profitability Target
wsjHeadlines.description: Shares rose 4%, taking the stock’s year-to-date gain to nearly 10%, after the bank said it is cutting costs and growing revenue to boost profitability through the end of the decade, including widening its use of AI.

wsjHeadlines.description: The report, commissioned by Trump ally Michelle Bowman, blamed bank-supervision staff in the Biden era.

wsjHeadlines.title: Stock Futures Nudge Higher as Markets Weigh Middle East Diplomacy

wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, a GOP senator calls for a Don Jr. probe and higher education looks to adapt.

wsjHeadlines.description: European stock indexes rose at the open, with banking and technology stocks lifting the Stoxx 600.

wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. stocks ended mixed as buzz about AI products propelled large tech companies to more record highs even as energy inflation fears lingered.

wsjHeadlines.title: Tech-Stocks Rise as Oil Sinks Below $100
wsjHeadlines.description: The Nasdaq Composite Index was poised for a second straight record high as falling oil prices helped U.S. tech stocks stay buoyant.

wsjHeadlines.title: European Utilities to Gain From Higher Natural Gas Prices
wsjHeadlines.description: A basket of European utilities stocks rose and Bank of America said European utilities’ earnings will benefit from higher-for-longer natural gas prices on the continent.

wsjHeadlines.description: The blockade proves the success of sanctions. If the U.S. keeps its chokehold, Tehran will likely break.

wsjHeadlines.description: The agency wants to stop telling companies how to handle shareholder resolutions.

wsjHeadlines.title: Oil Prices Mixed as Traders Weigh U.S.-Iran Talks, Saudi Pipeline Progress
wsjHeadlines.description: Saudi Arabia has begun testing its East-West pipeline for structural integrity and pressure, and American officials engaged in talks with Iranian peers on the sidelines of the United Nations General Assembly.

wsjHeadlines.title: Gold Pressured by Interest-Rate Outlook
wsjHeadlines.description: Gold fell and continued to trade in a tight range, as prospects of higher interest rates to curb persistent inflation weighed on prices.

wsjHeadlines.title: Oil Falls on Hopes for U.S.-Iran Talks
wsjHeadlines.description: Oil prices fell in early European trading on hopes for a diplomatic solution to the Middle East war and as Saudi Arabia began efforts to restart a critical pipeline.

wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on the U.S. clean-energy industry, Voestalpine,  Chinese and European aluminum output and more in the latest Market Talks covering Basic Materials.

wsjHeadlines.title: Dollar Jumps to 8-Week High as Fed Rate-Hike Bets Outweigh Lower Oil Prices

wsjHeadlines.description: The dollar rose to an almost eight-week high against a basket of currencies, driven by expectations the Fed could raise interest rates further.
